notes.title: Sea Walker Saga demo update
notes.content:
Friends, listening to your feedback, we decided to finalize the demo version! You may have already noticed new colorful covers from our artist, but the project has been transformed not only visually

[b]The following fixes are already available:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an old critical bug on Archipelago related to the controller and interaction
[*] Added a new tutorial system
[*] Removed unnecessary details from scenes
[*] Fixed environment lodes
[*] Added loading icon on the loading screen
[*] Minor fixes with character getting stuck between islands on Archipelago
[*] Added new textures to islands
[*] Updated borders with colliders on Marco Island
[*] Improved vegetation shaders: notice by grass and FPS
[*] Redesigned materials on all characters: now there is no pronounced blue edge on clothes and skin
[*] Changed final cutscene
[*] Added a couple of new auxiliary hints
[*] Other small edits to make the game more comfortable
[/list]
[b]Enjoy your journey across the vast seas in search of the mythical continent![/b]

notes.title: Sea Walker Saga: genre, setting, idea
notes.content:
Probably most of you from the title have already decided that it will be about sea battles on ships. But no.

[h2]The setting[/h2]
Steampunk - 1878.

A worldwide flood has swallowed everything. The world turned into an endless ocean. To survive, people had to learn to create their own islands, and to trade and communicate, they had to animate them.

With the help of special machines and engines, the islands learned to swim. The main character will get his own island for adventure. Together with him you will have to revive the island and go on it on an endless journey across the boundless seas in search of the mythical continent. Sea and air battles, exploring underwater depths and searching for allies for survival will accompany you throughout the journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45232928/17c851f0e357a8107aa0d5a888a1757c2ddc3751.jpg[/img]

[h2]Genre[/h2]
RTS and 3rd-person simulation with RPG elements.

[h2]How was the idea born?[/h2]
Back in the 2000's there was one amazing game called Project Nomads. It had no story at all. The head of our studio played it for the sake of gameplay variety. He replayed it several times.

While playing that game, he had ideas on how to make a much more interesting and large-scale project. And also to add a terrific story. It was then, in 2004, that the first rudiments of Sea Walker were born.
And as Sherlock says, the ideas were folded into the Mind's Heights. 

Today, our team pulls all the ideas out of the wormhole and puts them into game design, script and a unique universe.

[b]We're confident that Sea Walker Saga will be truly addictive. And not only with gameplay, but also with an engaging story![/b]
